About Us
Gismart is a value-driven mobile app developer with a strong presence in the Health & Wellness, Utilities, and Music app markets. We have recently achieved a significant milestone of over 1 billion downloads worldwide, taking a step toward our mission of cultivating the well-being of people worldwide. With headquarters in London, UK, Gismart is a dynamic global company with a reach extending across Europe and far beyond. Our team consists of 400+ professionals who bring diversity, creativity, innovation, and relentless drive to the company. Gismart unites professionals from diverse backgrounds in entertainment, music, and tech, allowing us to play to each other’s strengths and succeed as a team.

Our mission:
Become a stepping stone on our customers’ journeys of self-improvement.

Our values:

- Deliver what matters

- Respect and support others

- Initiate and own

- Voice openly

- Execute with quality

If you are passionate about mobile app development and want to work with a company that’s reshaping the industry, Gismart is the place for you. We offer exciting opportunities for professional growth, a supportive and collaborative environment, and the chance to contribute to products that make a tangible impact.
For more information about Gismart, visit gismart.com http://gismart.com.

About project:
Spilio is a product that helps people grow through developing essential soft skills. We combine practical learning with thoughtfully curated ideas from powerful books. Spilio is designed for helping people become more confident, self-aware, and effective in their everyday lives.

Requirements:

- 1+ year of experience working with mobile applications

- Knowledge of and hands-on experience with the latest AI tools (Kling, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, etc.)

- Proficiency in Adobe After Effects

- Basic knowledge of Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma

- A portfolio showcasing completed projects

- Understanding of the basic principles of video editing and animation

- Knowledge of Adobe After Effects plugins

Would be a plus:

- Experience conducting basic competitor research for creative ideas and references

- Staying up to date with social media trends and continuously expanding visual awareness

- Keeping up with emerging AI tools and exploring their potential for creative work

Responsibilities

- Design and animate performance-driven video creatives for Meta, TikTok, Google, AppLovin, and Snapchat

- Collaborate with the Creative Producer and UA team on briefs, hypotheses, and rapid iterations

- Adapt winning concepts into multiple variations: hooks, lengths, aspect ratios, languages, audiences

- Edit footage (UGC, stock, screen captures, app gameplay) into polished, on-brand videos

- Maintain visual consistency and quality at high cadence – multiple creatives per week

- Use AI-powered tools to speed up production (image/video generation, voice synthesis, asset clean-up) where it makes sense

- Stay current with motion trends and platform-native ad formats

What We Offer

- Remote-First Culture: Our team is as diverse and international as our product portfolio. We offer a flexible schedule and the opportunity to collaborate remotely from anywhere in the world or from one of our corporate hubs.

- Coworking Compensation: We provide 100% compensation for coworking spaces in Ukraine (except Kyiv, where we have a cozy and autonomous hub) and 50% compensation for coworking spaces worldwide, ensuring a comfortable and inspiring workspace.

- Free Office Lunches: Enjoy delicious, complimentary lunches when working from our corporate hubs.

- Public Holidays Policy: We provide 12 public holidays per year, accrued at a rate of one day per month.

- Sick Leave Support: We provide 100% compensation for sick leave.

- Mental and Physical Health: We partially cover medical insurance, sports activities, and therapy costs to support your well-being.

- Equipment Support: We provide the equipment needed for your projects or cover the maintenance costs of your own equipment.

- Learning and Development: We cover 70% of professional development course costs and 100% of corporate English course costs.

- Time Off: Team members receive 18 working days of paid time off and 3 personal days per year, with an additional day for each year of collaboration with Gismart.

- Corporate Events: Although we collaborate remotely, we value in-person connections. Whenever possible, we organize corporate events and team-building activities across our Gismart hubs.
